overview: Studio Art Engine is a professional, high-fidelity NFT generative art platform for advanced and institutional creators. It enables users to build, manage, and export large-scale NFT collections with advanced trait, rarity, and rules management — featuring pixel-perfect Apple-grade UI/UX, Liquid Glass effects, and direct IPFS (Pinata) integration.
features: Layer-based NFT generation with drag-and-drop traits
Advanced rarity workshop with precision sliders and auto-balancing
Real-time canvas preview with blend modes and GIF support
Vault with faceted filtering, rarity ranking, and bulk export
IPFS publishing via Pinata with full folder-based workflow
Apple-grade UI with Liquid Glass effects and premium motion system
Support for Ethereum, Polygon, Base, BNB, and Solana metadata standards
